description: Aluminum round tube, 5" OD x 0.25" wall — drum shell
controlling_spec: 6061-T6, 5" OD, 0.25" wall (ID 4.5"). Wall is a stiffness requirement, not cosmetic: I = 10.55 in^4.
substitution_rule: Any 6061 or 6063 tube with OD 5.000 -0.000/+0.030 and wall >= 0.180 in. Do NOT substitute thin-wall decorative tube: wall drives the stiffness in CALC-C02.
search_query: 6061 aluminum round tube 5" OD 0.25" wall

description: Precision-ground rotary shaft, 1.25" dia — drum shaft
controlling_spec: 1.25" dia, ground and polished, straightness <= 0.001"/ft, surface finish suitable for a set-screw insert.
mating_parts: P-010 shaft, H-001/H-002 bearings, P-021 plugs, H-004 sheave
substitution_rule: 1045 TG&P or 1566 ground shafting, 1.25" -0.001/-0.000. Hot-rolled bar is NOT acceptable: TIR would consume the whole alignment budget.
search_query: precision ground rotary shaft 1.25 inch diameter

description: Mounted ball bearing, 1.25" bore, self-aligning insert
controlling_spec: 1.25" bore, spherical-seat (self-aligning) insert, set-screw or eccentric-collar locking, sealed. REQUIRED basic dynamic capacity C >= 137 lbf for 5000 h at 1208 rpm. Static misalignment capability >= 0.011 deg.
mating_parts: P-001L (fixed), P-023 idler adjust plate (floating), P-010 shaft
substitution_rule: Any 2- or 4-bolt flange or pillow block meeting the bore, the C requirement and the self-aligning requirement. Confirm C on the vendor page; a bearing chosen by bore alone is not specified.
search_query: mounted ball bearing flange 1.25 inch bore self-aligning

description: Aluminum round bar, 4-1/2" dia — drum end plugs
controlling_spec: 6061-T6 round bar, >= 4.5" dia. Turn to a light press/bond fit in the shell ID and bore 1.25" H7-equivalent for the shaft.
mating_parts: P-021 plug, P-020 shell, P-010 shaft
substitution_rule: Phenolic or hard maple acceptable for Option B only; aluminum preferred because it holds the bore under humidity change.
search_query: 6061 aluminum round bar 4-1/2 inch diameter

controlling_spec: Two-piece or single-piece clamping collar, 1.25" bore, steel or aluminum. Used to locate the plugs axially and to set the fixed-bearing shoulder. Clamp type only — set-screw collars mar the ground shaft.
mating_parts: P-010 shaft, P-021 plugs, H-001 bearing
substitution_rule: Any clamp-style collar of the correct bore. Set-screw collars are excluded by interface, not by preference.
search_query: clamping shaft collar 1.25 inch bore two piece

description: Socket head cap screw, 1/4-28 — parallelism micro-adjust jack
controlling_spec: 1/4-28 x 1-1/2" alloy socket head cap screw. Fine thread is the requirement: lead 0.03571" gives 0.26 mil at the work per 15 deg of knob.
mating_parts: P-023 idler adjust plate, P-024 jack block
substitution_rule: M6x0.75 acceptable if the lead is recomputed and the sheet is revised. Do NOT use 1/4-20: resolution degrades ~40%.
search_query: 1/4-28 socket head cap screw alloy steel 1-1/2 long

controlling_spec: 1/4-20 brass-tipped or nylon-tipped set screw. Brass tip loads the gib without embedding in it.
substitution_rule: Any tipped set screw. A bare steel set screw is excluded: it brinells the gib and the setting drifts.
search_query: brass tipped set screw 1/4-20

description: Hardened dowel pin, 3/8" x 2" — idler plate pivot
controlling_spec: 3/8" x 2" hardened, ground dowel pin. The pivot must not wear oval or the parallelism setting walks.
mating_parts: P-023 idler adjust plate, P-001R side
substitution_rule: Ground shoulder bolt of the same diameter is acceptable.
search_query: hardened precision dowel pin 3/8 x 2

description: Dial indicator, 1" travel, 0.001" graduations + magnetic base
controlling_spec: Travel >= 1", resolution 0.001", lug or stem back. Magnetic base with a fine adjust. This is the instrument that proves ALN-01 and TV-01.
mating_parts: Q-101 acceptance, indicator pad on P-001L
substitution_rule: 0.0005" indicator or a digital caliper in wooden blocks. A tape measure cannot verify this specification.
search_query: dial indicator 1 inch travel 0.001 graduation magnetic base

controlling_spec: 1/2-10 single-lead Acme, steel. Lead 0.100"/rev gives 2.50 mil per handwheel division.
mating_parts: P-016 nut block, P-018 thrust block, H-008 chain
substitution_rule: 1/2-10 2-start acme is NOT interchangeable: it doubles the lead and halves the resolution. Revise the sheet if used.
search_query: 1/2-10 acme threaded rod lead screw

controlling_spec: Bronze or acetal Acme nut to match MC-10 lead. Flanged preferred so it can be bolted to P-016.
substitution_rule: Any nut matching the screw lead and axial load. Verify the thread is the same hand and lead as MC-10.
search_query: bronze acme nut 1/2-10

qty: 1 x 3 ft chain, 2 sprockets, 1 connecting link
controlling_spec: #25 roller chain, two matched sprockets 1/2" bore with set screw. Equal tooth count is mandatory — unequal sprockets tilt the table.
substitution_rule: Timing belt and matched pulleys are acceptable and quieter. Tooth counts must be equal.
search_query: roller chain 25 sprocket 1/2 inch bore

controlling_spec: Handwheel >= 4" dia, 1/2" bore, with a graduated or markable rim. 40 divisions -> 2.50 mil per division.
substitution_rule: Plain handwheel plus a shop-made paper dial is acceptable if graduation count is recorded on Q-102.
search_query: handwheel graduated dial 1/2 inch bore 4 inch

description: UHMW bar, 3/4" x 2-1/2" — vertical ways and gib
controlling_spec: UHMW-PE bar 3/4" x 2-1/2". Two ways plus gib stock plus spare. Dry bearing: wax only, never oil.
substitution_rule: Acetal or cast nylon acceptable; both move more with humidity than UHMW. PTFE is too soft for the gib.
search_query: UHMW polyethylene bar 3/4 x 2-1/2

description: Canvas or linen phenolic sheet, 1/2" — table wear face
controlling_spec: 1/2" canvas-base phenolic. This is DATUM-D, the metrology surface. Flatness after bonding must be <= 3 mil over the 15.5" contact line.
substitution_rule: 3/8" MIC-6 cast aluminum plate is a better metrology surface and an acceptable substitute. Ordinary rolled plate is not: it is not flat enough.
search_query: canvas phenolic sheet 1/2 inch thick

controlling_spec: 5" pitch dia, A/4L section, 1.25" bore, keyed or set-screw. With the 3.5" motor sheave this gives 1208 rpm.
substitution_rule: Any A/4L sheave of the same pitch diameter and bore. Changing diameter changes surface speed — recompute CALC-C12.
search_query: v-belt pulley 5 inch 1.25 inch bore A section

controlling_spec: 3.5" pitch dia, A/4L section, bore to match the motor shaft (MEASURE it — 5/8" is common but not universal).
substitution_rule: Match pitch diameter and the measured motor bore.
search_query: v-belt pulley 3.5 inch A section 5/8 bore

qty: 1 ea (size after the cradle is locked)
controlling_spec: A/4L section. Length is measured, not predicted: lock the motor cradle, then measure the centre distance and compute pitch length.
substitution_rule: Link belt is an acceptable and quieter substitute.
search_query: 4L v-belt

controlling_spec: Light compression spring, ~3/4" OD, free length ~2". Light is the requirement: a stiff spring bows thin stock and you sand a banana.
substitution_rule: Any spring that lets a 1/16" board pass without visible bow.
search_query: compression spring 3/4 od 2 inch free length light

controlling_spec: 5/16" shoulder screw x 1-1/2". Shoulder gives a true pivot; a threaded bolt in a wood bearing wallows.
substitution_rule: Ground dowel plus retaining collar.
search_query: shoulder screw 5/16 x 1-1/2

description: 4" dust hose, cuff and blast gate
controlling_spec: 4" ID flex hose, one cuff, one blast gate. The collector must deliver 349 CFM AT THE MACHINE — hood face velocity 609 fpm.
substitution_rule: Any 4" fitting. A shop vacuum will NOT meet the CFM requirement and will clog — this is a capacity requirement, not a connector preference.
search_query: 4 inch dust collection hose blast gate cuff

controlling_spec: Two-part structural epoxy rated for metal-to-metal bonding, with a published open time long enough to seat the plugs.
substitution_rule: Any structural metal-bonding epoxy with published shear strength and cure schedule. Do not use general-purpose 5-minute epoxy.
design_basis: J-106; user standard: never glue alone for primary structure
search_query: two part structural epoxy adhesive metal bonding

controlling_spec: 4" hook strip with pressure-sensitive adhesive; 3" loop-backed abrasive. Abrasive thickness variation is 2 mil of the TV-01 budget — buy one brand and stay with it.
substitution_rule: Any loop-backed abrasive of consistent thickness.
search_query: hook and loop sanding drum wrap abrasive roll 3 inch

description: Hex bolts, nylock nuts and backing washers — frame through-bolts
controlling_spec: 1/4-20 hex bolt with a large-OD backing washer under both head and nut. Through-bolted frame is re-tightenable and knock-down.
substitution_rule: 3/8" bolts acceptable; screws alone are excluded by the user joinery standard.
search_query: 1/4-20 hex bolt 3 inch nylock nut fender washer

controlling_spec: 3/8-16 male adjustable handle or star knob. Way locks and yoke locks.
substitution_rule: Any 3/8-16 knob with a comfortable grip.
search_query: adjustable handle 3/8-16 star knob
